newsitem.title: USA: American Financial revises Q4 results.
newsitem.headline: American Financial revises Q4 results.

text.p: American Financial Group Inc on Thursday said it revised its fourth-quarter results to show a net loss, instead of a profit, after writing down a $35 million investment in a company.

American Financial said it posted a loss of $1.9 million, or $0.03 per share, revising its initial report of net earnings of $20.8 million, or $0.34 per share. Earnings were first reported on February 26.
The insurance company revised its earnings for the year to $233.3 million, or $3.84 per share, from $256 million, or $4.21.
It said it decided to take the charge in its fourth-quarter after American Eagle Group Inc reported a $39.9 million loss for its 1996 fourth quarter on March 24.
American Financial Group is engaged in specialty and multi-line property and casualty insurance businesses and in the sale of tax-deferred annuities and certain life and health insurance products.
